title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
taper: Audio discs provided by Greg Weister

ai_review.summary: Crisp audience recording of a scorching July‑31 1973 show, highlighted by an epic Playin' and tight China>Riders jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently high‑energy with every tune delivering A‑list quality – the 30‑minute Playin' is repeatedly called A+++ and the China Cat Sunflower segue into a Dark Stars/Riders “Joy” jam is praised for its intensity.  Although it’s an audience tape, listeners note a surprisingly clear and crisp sound that captures the crowd’s vibe, even if it isn’t audiophile perfect.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is described as exceptional by multiple reviewers (A+++ Playin', smoking set) while the audience recording is noted as unusually crisp and listenable, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the tape as surprisingly crispy for a 1973 audience recording, with enough crowd ambience to feel present; not audiophile‑grade but very listenable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > Dark Stars/Riders ("Joy" jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set lacks secondary jams but stays hot; second set is short, likely due to time constraints, yet every song is performed tightly and energetically.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is called "off the wall animated" with A+++ guitar work throughout the show.
